pf.visit.ladders: Ladders on firm, level ground, kept well clear of power lines, with stand-offs at the gutters. Anyone on a roof ties off first. No ladders in strong wind, rain or ice.
pf.visit.wind_on_the_day: Wind over the limit at the house: ground work is done today, roofline work moves to a new day at no cost, and it's billed once when it's all done.

pf.visit.drop_off: At the shop: the code is given at the counter when the box is left. Status words IN, READY. READY comes with a photo. Pick-up only by the customer or someone they name.
pf.visit.proof_done: After photos at dusk of each side of the house, or a video with the lights on when nobody is home.
pf.visit.breakage: Reported with photos the same day; the owner decides how to make it right.

pf.money.final: The rest after the install, with any change orders, on the bill Rosie texts (or the business's own way). The January takedown is in the price.
pf.money.takedown: Included in a list install and in a custom display; booked at the same time; a takedown-only job is $150 paid when booked
pf.money.plans: A season plan's terms show before any card and get their own yes; the saved card is charged at DONE of each season after a reminder; the customer can skip, pause or end by text

pf.edges.weather: Weather over the limit the day before: Rosie checks the forecast for each outside job; Sam keeps it or moves it, free.
pf.edges.wind_on_the_day: Wind at the house on the day: ground work done now, roofline moved free, one bill at the end.
pf.edges.power_line_or_gutter: A power line or a hanging gutter: safety steps first.
pf.edges.dark_sections: A section goes dark within 30 days: tell the business for a free fix. After that, a service call at the list price.
pf.edges.storm_damage: Storm or animal damage after install is a paid service call, with before and after photos.
pf.edges.late_order: The lights are late: the install moves, with no fee.
pf.edges.tripping_breaker: An outlet that keeps tripping: the crew stops; the client's electrician fixes the circuit first.

pf.edges.plan: Season plans: skip, pause or end, and a plan's price change.
pf.edges.unclaimed_strands: Strands left at the shop and not picked up: reminders; after the free days, a storage fee only if the owner starts it, after written notice.
pf.edges.rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
